parsed.hypothesis_statement: In a synthetic parametric strategy with all non-threshold decision rules held fixed, increasing the absolute signal threshold reduces trade count, such that threshold gating is the primary source of trade-count variation across otherwise identical simulations.
parsed.hypothesis_rationale: A threshold gate converts a continuous signal into discrete entry opportunities: raising the required signal magnitude excludes marginal observations that would otherwise trigger trades. Holding the signal-generating process and all other decision logic constant isolates whether this exclusion mechanism explains the observed variation in trade frequency.
